description: Video memory is 4 MB and paged. 'source' keeps the format each asset was authored with; setting it to pal8 cooks palettised instead, which is far cheaper per page at the cost of one colour-table page. The per-texture ceiling matches the largest slot the memory layout registers. See docs/ps2/TEXTURE_BUDGET.md. level_textures caps brush materials baked by the level compiler separately from standalone TEXTURE assets: a level pins every one of its materials for its whole lifetime, so even a modest per-texture size adds up fast across many unique brushes - 64x64 keeps a level's own material set affordable within the same page budget.
